summary: This bill reauthorizes the Office of Urban Agriculture and Innovative Production through fiscal year 2030 and increases its annual funding to $50,000,000.

scores.thoughts: This bill reauthorizes the Office of Urban Agriculture and Innovative Production and significantly increases its authorized funding from $25,000,000 for fiscal years 2019-2023 to $50,000,000 for fiscal years 2025-2030. This directly leads to more government spending.

By reauthorizing and increasing funding for the Office of Urban Agriculture and Innovative Production, the bill supports programs that can improve access to fresh produce in urban communities, which often benefits low-income populations and can be seen as a component of the social safety net by addressing food insecurity.

The bill's sole purpose is to reauthorize and double annual appropriations ($25M to $50M) for the Office of Urban Agriculture and Innovative Production through 2030, authorizing new federal spending with no offsets or revenue provisions mentioned.
